rev.t: I was instantly surprised by the vibe, quality and accessible pricing (according to mood). While it was crowded and there was absolutely no place to sit down because it was Sunday night, so obviously. But beyond that, I loved the spread, …
Glen’s Bakehouse is one of the most popular pastry shops in Bangalore, and we visited the place for dinner. Since it was a Saturday, the café was fully crowded, which shows how loved it is. …

This is one of favourite places in Banglore, loved the vibe the people and especially the desserts..
Great ambiance, friendly staff …
